1. As on June 30, 2026, ICICI Bank Limited, Promoter of the Company, also held 367 shares in the capacity of Clearing Member and the same is included in the Clearing Member category under Public, Non-institutional category.
2. As on June 30, 2026, Non-Resident Indians held 954,389 equity shares constituting 0.19% of the total paid up equity share capital of the Company whereas Non Resident Indians (Non Repatriable) held 1,227,580 equity shares constituting 0.25% of the total paid up equity share capital of the Company.
3. Voting Rights under Category "Public" include 4,729 equity shares held by Investor Education and Protection Fund (IEPF) Authority on which voting rights are frozen.
4. As per the records of shareholding as on June 30, 2026, the shareholding of ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company Limited (Promoter Group Entity) is 199,725 equity shares constituting 0.04% of the total paid up equity share capital of the Company. However, ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company Limited has bought 361 equity shares of the Company on June 30, 2026. On account of settlement cycle, buy transaction of 361 equity shares by Promoter Group Entity is not reflecting in the shareholding pattern.
5. For the purpose of Shareholding Pattern, Key Managerial Personnel (KMP) shall mean KMP as defined under Companies Act, 2013.
